name: zazz-vscode
description: Zazz Design Framework support for HTML: diagnostics, completions, hover, inlay hints, highlighting, formatting, snippets, and page templates.
author: Derek Nelsen

scripts.package: vp pack && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/zazz.vsix && node scripts/check-vsix.ts dist/zazz.vsix
scripts.test: vp pack && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vp test run
scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-grammar.ts && node scripts/generate-emmet.ts && node scripts/generate-snippets.ts

zazz.languages.markdownDescription: Language ids the Zazz language features run in. Plain HTML plus any templating language that embeds HTML: the server masks the language's expressions (`{…}`, `<%= %>`, `@Model.X`, `{{ }}`) before auditing, so only the markup is checked. Known ids: `astro`, `vue`, `svelte`, `razor`, `aspnetcorerazor`, `asp`, `aspx`, `erb`, `php`, `phoenix-heex`, `html-eex`, `eex`, `elixir` (inside `~H` sigils), `handlebars`, `mustache`, `twig`, `jinja`, `jinja-html`, `nunjucks`, `liquid`, `django-html`, `blade`. An unknown id is treated as plain HTML. The language client restarts when this changes.

zazz.diagnostics.enable.description: Report Zazz markup problems (the <ui-debug> audit) in HTML files.

zazz.inlayHints.enable.description: Show inlay hints in style attributes: scale numbers in rem, breakpoint thresholds, shorthand targets, and size token ranges.

zazz.colorSwatches.enable.description: Show a swatch before var(--color-*) values in style attributes, in the current theme's light or dark value.

zazz.templates.base.description: URL prefix to the kit's src/ contents in new pages (buildHead's base): where index.css, base/, and primitives/ are served.
